description: The Rutland's Vermont main line: Bellows Falls over Mount Holly summit to Rutland, north through the Otter Creek valley to Burlington, and the Island Line across the Lake Champlain causeways to Alburgh. Terrain export follows a sparse railway corridor approximately ten 500 m tiles wide. The Bennington leg, Chatham branch, and Ogdensburg division are outside the map budget and are clipped by the line bounds.

calibration.report: corridor probe (AWS terrarium z13) over the sparse corridor tiles, not the demScan rectangle
calibration.note: Lake Champlain (~28 m) shifts to ~505 m; Okemo above Ludlow (~987 m) shifts to ~1464 m. The demScan rectangle contains Killington (~1291 m), which sits outside the corridor, so scan_dem's rectangular feasibility check would reject a uniform offset that the actual corridor comfortably satisfies. Do not overwrite this offset from a rectangle scan.
